claim_summary: TimeMaster trains a multimodal LLM for structured time-series classification reasoning and recommendations using GPT-4o-generated warm-up pairs, SFT, and reward-driven GRPO.

claim_evidence.quote: Central to our approach is a structured output format that unifies the model’s response into three components: reasoning, classification, and extension.
To construct high-quality time series–text paired reasoning data for warm-up training, we adopt an automated pipeline leveraging GPT-4o via the OpenAI API

modules.name: Structured time-series reasoning post-training
modules.scope_reason: R2 places SFT/GRPO here because they update the multimodal model parameters to shape temporal reasoning outputs; R3 applies only to Harness modules. The reward is part of model training, not a task-specific runtime verifier (TSK) or temporal-data harness (GTS).

evidence.quote: The model is trained using a two-stage pipeline: we first apply supervised finetuning (SFT) to establish a good initialization, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the token level to enable stable and targeted rewarddriven improvement in time-series reasoning.

The format reward enforces strict adherence to the predefined output structure. A regex-based parser automatically checks if the generated response contains correctly nested and ordered <think>, <class>, and <extension> tags, with non-empty reasoning and classification spans.

modules.name: GPT-4o-generated reasoning warm-up data
modules.scope_reason: R2 explicitly places training data built to train the model on the LLM side; R3 applies only to Harness modules. The generated paired samples supervise the model, rather than serving as a temporal runtime store (GTS) or task-specific procedure (TSK).

evidence.quote: To construct high-quality time series–text paired reasoning data for warm-up training, we adopt an automated pipeline leveraging GPT-4o via the OpenAI API (with temperature set to 1.0 and all other parameters at default values).
Only samples whose predicted labels match the ground truth are retained as high-quality supervision. We collect approximately 1,000 class-balanced samples per dataset.
